title: Old Dirt Main Menu
description: bring back the background, button layout, music, and toasts of 1.7.3
body:
the menu never looked better than **1.7.3**

this mod is a pixel-perfect and detail-oriented recreation of that menu, going beyond a simple texture swap.

- authentic visual resources from mojang
- only the music from 1.7.3
- version-accurate yellow bouncing toast text (microsoft have binned a lot)
- button layout restored and microsoft buttons removed

the mod currently supports the NeoForge 'Mods' button and Iris + Optifine 'Shaders' in the new layout, works with sodium video settings changes such as the new sodium, and reeses options.
